notes.title: Ver 1.0.4 is now live
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Just a quick update on some bug fixes.

Fix:
Game would not scale properly to full screen on screen resolutions higher than 1080p

Fix:
Game was running too fast on monitors with high refresh rates. The game should now run at the correct speed on any refresh rate.
Thank you to Peppage for pointing that out.
This fix will also ensure the ship does not move too fast in the shooter sections.

Change:
I also felt that the steering became way too twitchy on high refresh rate monitors so in the pause menu I have added a steering option - Light and Heavy.
If you find the steering too twitchy just change it to heavy in the options menu or change it to light if steering is feeling  too slow/heavy.
Light mode should be fine for 60hz monitors and Heavy mode for 144hz etc.

If you find any other issues please let me know.
Thank you

notes.title: Race Day is here
notes.content:
Grid Gunner is out!

Time to get into those Gunners and take on and overcome the challenges of the four zones.
Who will be the first to complete all 12 tracks?

Please feel free to reach out if you have any comments, issues or just want to talk about the game.

Good luck Gunners!

notes.title: Race Day is around the corner
notes.content:
Hello Fellow gamers!

Grid Gunner is almost here and I am looking forward to letting it out in the wild and building a community for the game. 
This game is a solo Indie project and  I hope it will  resonate  with many players and that you will get  plenty of enjoyment from it and also be challenged by what lies ahead.

I will be here to listen and engage with you all and take all criticism, good an bad as valuable information to learn from so please do talk and share your thoughts as it is important to me.
